module.Title: Describe a Pump
module.Teaching: A dictionary stores named key-value pairs inside braces. It is useful for related equipment attributes.
module.PredictionQuestion: How do you access the pump name?
module.PredictionExplanation: Use the key inside square brackets: pump["name"].
module.DebugPrompt: Dictionary entries belong inside braces, not square brackets.
module.RecallPrompt: Create the pump dictionary from memory. Use these exact values: 1, 125, "Transfer Pump 1", True, "hours", "name", "running".
module.TransferPrompt: Create a fan dictionary with name EF-1, running False, and hours 82.
module.PreviewMessage: Equipment details are now grouped into meaningful records.
